Application Data.NAME: Elegant Blooms Floral Supply Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Blooms Floral Supply Co. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality artificial flowers and floral supplies. Our operations include a brick-and-mortar store where customers can browse an extensive selection of floral arrangements, crafting materials, and decorative accessories. We maintain a secured, climate-controlled storage area for our inventory to ensure product integrity and safety. Our services also extend to basic floral design consultations for personal and corporate events, with a focus on high customer satisfaction and adherence to industry best practices. While we offer moderate delivery services, our online sales are kept below 50% of total revenue, allowing us to prioritize in-store customer experiences. We have a documented low-claims history, which reflects our commitment to operational excellence and risk management. Seasonally, we prepare for increased demand during holidays and events, ensuring sufficient inventory and staffing to manage peaks effectively.

The claim was promptly filed and is currently in the process of being resolved with the insurance provider.
